description.value: Meat & Bread is a well-known Vancouver sandwich chain whose Pender Street location sits in the heart of the downtown financial district, celebrated for its signature porchetta sandwich with salsa verde and crackling. The restaurant offers breakfast sandwiches, salads, soups, and its namesake hot sandwiches with both indoor and outdoor seating. A catering and group-orders option adds practical appeal for organized cycling groups moving through the urban core.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Pender Street location of the Meat & Bread chain at 1033 W Pender St, Vancouver, consistent with OSM tags. The menu explicitly lists vegetarian sandwich options and the site offers order pickup and delivery.
